subject: [Invite] Encord AI Leaders Dinner @ Kokkari SF - Thursday February 27th
text:
Hi [NAME],

Our Co-Founders, [SENDER] & [SENDER], will be hosting an intimate Physical AI
roundtable dinner for customers & CxOs and we'd love for you to join if
you're available.

We've booked a private dining room at Kokkari in San Francisco on Thursday
February 27th 6:30-9:30pm, capping attendance to ~25 people.

Attendees include Co-Founders, CEO's, CTOs & Heads of ML etc. from leading
VC-backed scale-ups such as Archetype AI, Physical Intelligence, Cobot, The
Bot Company etc. We will also be joined by a few of our investors,
including Next47 and CRV.

In case you're not familiar with Encord - we're an SF-based data
development platform (recently raised our Series B) built to help computer
vision teams get better models to market, faster. For context, we're
working with many leaders in the Gen AI space doing similarly great things
to Hive like Caption and Synthesia.

Thought it was a good opportunity to get connected - would you be
interested in joining? We have one seat left.

text:
